comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/1432101063 (Alpine Valley, landuse=winter_sports): the hill north of US 322 (Mayfield Road) at Chesterland in Geauga County, Ohio, from the top of the Snowbelt, the Pine and the Handle Tow down to the Main Lodge, the F&B Lodge and Sycamore Lake, on one ticket and one map (Epic, Vail Resorts; not Wisconsin's Alpine Valley); it holds every lift and run, and no part of the resort is reached only by shuttle or road. OpenStreetMap has the polygon twice: way/1432790358 is the same ring of the same 27 nodes with the same name (and official_name), so the older way is the ski area and the copy, which is no other resort, is left as it is. No other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-14 against Alpine Valley's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_AV_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map alpinevalleyohio.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links as the Alpine Valley Winter 2025-2026 Trail Map; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF's painting, an image with no text layer, rendered at two and five times its size and read tile by tile), the newest the resort publishes. Its key: Easier (green circle), More Difficult (blue square), Most Difficult (black diamond; no double black), Freestyle Terrain (orange) and Slow Zone, read as OSM's easy, intermediate and advanced; its lifts are the Snowbelt (double chair), Sycamore Lake (triple), The Pine (quad), the Handle Tow and the Carpet Lift, as the resort's mountain-info page counts them (9 trails, 5 lifts, 1 terrain park, read 2026-11-14). The resort's lift and terrain status loads by script, so the printed map is the source and wins. All nine of the map's trails are in OSM, each with the map's rating. Names from the map: Exhibition and Upper Exhibition (OSM Expedition and Pine Cone/Upper Expedition) and Main Street (OSM Mainstreet). Parks: 322 Park, the map's one freestyle-terrain trail (orange), an unrated downhill run in OSM, gets the park flag (its rating stays unknown, as nothing rates it). Hidden: OSM's Double Chair, tagged abandoned=yes, between the Snowbelt and the Pine, where the map draws no lift. OSM difference that an override cannot fix: the map gives the Snowbelt its double-chair symbol, OSM aerialway:occupancy=3 (the ski file keeps OSM's occupancy). OSM gaps: none of the map's trails or lifts is missing.

overrides.reason: Expedition: the blue run from the Pine's top down the middle of the hill to the Main Lodge, which Alpine Valley's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_AV_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map alpinevalleyohio.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF rendered at two and five times its size) labels EXHIBITION with a blue square. Name from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Pine Cone/Upper Expedition: the short black run from the summit by the Handle Tow towards Exhibition, which Alpine Valley's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_AV_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map alpinevalleyohio.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF rendered at two and five times its size) labels UPPER EXHIBITION with a black diamond. Name from the map (Pine Cone is not on it); OSM's rating is the map's.

Mainstreet: the blue run beside the Snowbelt from the top to the base, which Alpine Valley's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_AV_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map alpinevalleyohio.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF rendered at two and five times its size) labels MAIN STREET with a blue square. Spelling from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

322 Park: the run between The Meadow and Exhibition, which Alpine Valley's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_AV_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map alpinevalleyohio.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF rendered at two and five times its size) draws in orange with the orange Freestyle Terrain pill and labels 322 PARK, the resort's one terrain park (its mountain-info page, read 2026-11-14), so it gets the park flag; OSM gives it no rating, and none is guessed.

Double Chair (OSM's double chair tagged abandoned=yes, 344 m, between the Snowbelt and the Pine): Alpine Valley's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251113_AV_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map alpinevalleyohio.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page and the PDF were read with WebFetch, the PDF rendered at two and five times its size) draws no lift there (Main Street and The Meadow run where it stood), and the resort's mountain-info page (read 2026-11-14) counts five lifts, the map's Snowbelt, Sycamore Lake, The Pine, Handle Tow and Carpet Lift. A lift the resort no longer runs.
